name: thinwindow
description: Less in the window. Less on the bill. Your agent pays for its context twice: once to cache it, then again on every turn that re-reads it. The re-reads alone are 87–96% of tokens; the two payments together are 73–84% of the bill. ThinWindow is a Claude Code plugin and an Agent Skill that shrinks the context: 13–19% fewer tokens, measured in Claude Code on three models, on eight tasks in two Python and JavaScript repositories.
